title: C++Now 2018: Matt Godbolt “What Else Has My Compiler Done For Me Lately?”
summary: Matt Godbolt, creator of Compiler Explorer, tours surprising optimizations modern compilers perform, such as turning loops into closed-form sums and using popcount instructions. He explores what the compiler does behind the scenes.
why: HN recommends it as a detailed, entertaining look at the crazy optimizations compilers do.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: Both are great presentations going into details on some of the crazy optimizations compilers will do.
